new_defects_found.description: §23 states: 'PTR Specification schema version is declared at the top of this file (16.1.0)'. The schema version declared at the top of this file is 16.3.0. This is an internal factual contradiction in the primary schema compatibility section.
new_defects_found.why_material: §23 is the normative schema identification section. Declaring 16.1.0 as the schema version in the body while the header declares 16.3.0 creates a directly contradictory normative claim. Under stack-architect §10, filename version tokens must match the artifact's declared Schema Version header. §23 violates this internally. Governor and Architect schema-version routing may misread the schema identity.

new_defects_found.why_material: This is the normative compatibility declaration for the PTR Specification. This is a version-identity defect in the most authoritative compatibility statement of the artifact.

new_defects_found.description: compatibility.cosyn_core_generation is '16.1.0' while required_core_generation is '16.3.0' (line 9). These two fields within the same manifest assert contradictory Core generation values.
new_defects_found.why_material: A package manifest that declares required_core_generation: 16.3.0 (meaning only Core 16.3.0 is acceptable) and simultaneously declares compatibility.cosyn_core_generation: 16.1.0 (naming a prior generation) is internally self-contradictory. Bolt-on manifests reading cosyn_core_generation to validate Core compatibility would receive a false older value, potentially enabling wrong-version stack assembly.
